feedback: Repair applicability logic. The top-level nltl:iceClass sh:in restriction makes the outside-class non-applicability branch impossible and falsely invalidates non-applicable ships. Remove that restriction (retain required controlled iceClass evidence), and replace the two non-applicability sh:sparql branches: SHACL SPARQL constraints conform when their SELECT returns no rows, so the current date<2003-09-01 and class-NOT-IN queries are inverted inside sh:or and can let applicable or inapplicable cases pass accidentally. Encode positive alternatives with SHACL Core constraints, such as constructionStageDate sh:maxExclusive 2003-09-01 and a sh:not wrapper around the applicable-class sh:in constraint, while retaining the applicable branch and all declared operand, relationship, result, datatype, and unit checks.

Do not attach upperIceWaterlineLength and upperIceWaterlineBreadth to the hasLowerIceWaterline node. Those properties belong to the upper ice-waterline owner, and duplicating them on the lower waterline targets the right properties on the wrong entity. Retain the dimensions only on the hasUpperIceWaterline node and encode the lower calculation's use of those same upper-waterline dimensions through the appropriate declared calculation/path structure, while preserving both resistance inputs, both result terms, and the mcrPower >= each-result comparison.
